name: Axomadol
summary: Axomadol (INN, USAN) (code name EN3324) is a synthetic, centrally-acting opioid analgesic related to tramadol which was under investigation by Endo Pharmaceuticals in collaboration with Grünenthal GmbH for the treatment of chronic, moderate to severe lower back pain and arthrosis. Development was halted after phase II clinical trials as it did not meet the pre-determined clinical endpoints.

uses.text: Axomadol (INN, USAN) (code name EN3324) is a synthetic, centrally-acting opioid analgesic related to tramadol which was under investigation by Endo Pharmaceuticals in collaboration with Grünenthal GmbH for the treatment of chronic, moderate to severe lower back pain and arthrosis. Development was halted after phase II clinical trials as it did not meet the pre-determined clinical endpoints.

pharmacology.en: Like tramadol, it acts on the mu-opioid receptor and also blocks the reuptake of noradrenaline and serotonin, so pain relief comes from both an opioid and a non-opioid route.
pharmacology.zh: 和曲馬多一樣，它作用於 μ 鴉片受體，同時阻斷正腎上腺素與血清素的回收，因此止痛效果同時來自鴉片與非鴉片兩條途徑。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和曲马多一样，它作用于 μ 鸦片受体，同时阻断正肾上腺素与血清素的回收，因此止痛效果同时来自鸦片与非鸦片两条途径。

sideEffects.en: It never reached the market, so its effects in people are not well documented. Tramadol-like drugs cause nausea, dizziness, drowsiness and constipation, can lower the seizure threshold, and raise the risk of serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 它從未上市，因此對人體的作用紀錄不多。類曲馬多藥物會造成噁心、頭暈、嗜睡與便祕，可能降低癲癇發作的閾值，並提高血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它从未上市，因此对人体的作用纪录不多。类曲马多药物会造成恶心、头晕、嗜睡与便秘，可能降低癫痫发作的阈值，并提高血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: It is related to tramadol, which Grünenthal in Germany first made in the 1960s. Like tramadol it was designed to work on two systems at once rather than on opioid receptors alone.
fact.zh: 它與曲馬多有關，曲馬多是德國 Grünenthal 公司在 1960 年代首次合成的。和曲馬多一樣，它的設計是同時作用於兩個系統，而非只作用於鴉片受體。
fact.zhHans: 它与曲马多有关，曲马多是德国 Grünenthal 公司在 1960 年代首次合成的。和曲马多一样，它的设计是同时作用于两个系统，而非只作用于鸦片受体。
